reason: The hypothesis directly restates the finding from P8 and P33 that increasing Al content in CoCrFeNiMnX alloys changes the oxide from Mn-based, porous, non-protective scales to a thin, protective Al2O3 scale, and frames this known result as a prediction. The mechanism (Al affinity, vacancy diffusion) is taken from the same passages and general knowledge. The proposed comparison of Al vs. Mn/Si is the same study already reported in P8 and P33, with Si added as a minor variant without new justification.
copied_elements: Al forms protective Al2O3 scale (P2, P8, P33)
Mn leads to non-protective, porous oxides (P1, P8, P33)
comparison of Al vs Mn in CoCrFeNi-based alloys (P8, P33)
mechanism: Al2O3 is dense and adherent, Mn oxides are defective (P1, P8)
